Name: Terrible Luau Soup
Author: erzvolnes
Description:
Want your Luau soup to truly reflect your worst decisions? Here you go. 

Adds Lewis' shorts, entire jars of mayonnaise, and Red Mushrooms to the Luau Soup. (Or just Lewis' shorts with the default soup texture, if simplicity is more your style.)

If you'd like your soup to look a little nicer instead, check out my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44146]Tastier Luau[/url] mod.
[b]
Installation: [/b]
[list]
[*]Make sure you have both Content Patcher and SMAPI working
[*]Download the desired mod
[*]Unzip it into your StardewValley/Mods folder
[*]Launch the game with SMAPI
[*]Done!
[/list]
